$comment: B-WORKFLOW-IMPROVE OBJ-1 (Q1). One traceability ledger per batch: objective -> intent -> components -> entry points -> readers -> plan item -> diff -> tests -> Step-7 proof -> Step-8 challenge -> status. DRAFT, non-blocking until the OBJ-9 pilot. Checked by ledger-validate.mjs, which reads the required-field lists below; this file is the single statement of them.

objective_fields.intent: what Kyle means by done for this objective, in one sentence
objective_fields.components: array of component names (System Impact Map names)
objective_fields.entry_points: array of entry points that reach the change (census output)
objective_fields.readers: array of reader objects, each with reader_required fields
objective_fields.plan_item: pre-audit implementation-plan item id, e.g. Q3
objective_fields.diff: array of {path, ref} the objective changed
objective_fields.unproven: required when status is closed-unproven: object with unproven_required fields
objective_fields.missed_earlier: array of {what, found_at_step} - what an earlier step missed and which step found it
